## Libraries and variables
  
```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(lubridate)
library(terra)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
library(sparta)
library(tidyverse)

start_time <- Sys.time()

output_path <- str_glue('output/frescalo')
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| label: pg-download
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

montevideo_grids_iNat <- readRDS('data/montevideo_grids_iNat.rds')
```

## Elevation

```{r}
#| label: generate-elev-layer
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

elev <- elevation_30s(country='UY', path='data/')

elev_grids <- terra::extract(x = elev, 
                             y = montevideo_grids_iNat, 
                             fun = mean, na.rm=T, bind=T) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>% rename(elev=URY_elv_msk)

saveRDS(elev_grids, str_glue('data/elev_grids.rds'))
rm(elev, elev_grids)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-elev-layer
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

elevation <- readRDS(str_glue('data/elev_grids.rds'))
```

## Data clean
  
```{r}
#| label: data-clean
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ecological data
ecological_data <- montevideo_grids_iNat %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(species=str_split(spsList, ';')) %>% 
  unnest(species) %>% 
  group_by(spsList) %>% mutate(sample = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(site=gridID, sample, taxa=species, effort=NR) %>% 
  filter(effort!=0)

# distance between grid cells
coordinates <- montevideo_grids_iNat %>% 
  st_centroid() %>% 
  st_coordinates() 

distances <- as.matrix(dist(coordinates)) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = 'x') %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -x,
               names_to = 'y',
               values_to = 'dist') %>%
  as.data.frame()

# habitat data
habitat <- elevation %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(site=gridID, elev) %>%
  as.data.frame()

weights <- createWeights(distances = distances,
                         attributes = habitat,
                         dist_sub = 20,
                         sim_sub = 10, verbose = F)

frescalo_data_time <- Sys.time()
frescalo_data_time - start_time
```

## Run Frescalo


```{r}
#| label: run-frescalo
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

frescalo_start_time <- Sys.time()

species_data <- atlas_data %>% st_drop_geometry()
frescalo_results <- frescalo(Data = species_data, 
                             frespath = paste0(getwd(),'/frescalo/Frescalo_3a_windows.exe'),
                             # time_periods = time_periods,
                             site_col = 'site',
                             sp_col = 'taxa',
                             year = 'year',
                             Fres_weights = weights,
                             sinkdir = paste0(getwd(),'/', output_path),
                             phi = NULL)


frescalo_end_time <- Sys.time()

# time to run frescalo
frescalo_end_time - frescalo_start_time
```

### Save files

```{r}
#| label: save-frescalo-files
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true


transfer_frescalo_files <- function(from='frescalo', to=output_path){
  files_to_transfer <- list.files(from, pattern = '*.txt', full.names = T)
  fs::file_move(files_to_transfer, to) #file.rename(from, to)
}

todays_date <- format(today(), "%y%m%d")
transfer_frescalo_files(to=str_glue('{output_path}/frescalo_{todays_date}'))
```

## Benchmark species

```{r}
#| label: alistair-functions
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

#---------- frescImport -----------#

frescImport<-function(folder){
	if(is.null(folder)){stop('Please supply a folder name')}
	if(!file.exists(folder)){stop('Folder not found')}
	
fresc.out<-list(
paths=NA, # not sure what is actually in this - need to look up sparta
trend=read.csv(paste0(folder,'/Output/Trend.csv')),
stat=read.csv(paste0(folder,'/Output/Stats.csv')),
freq=read.csv(paste0(folder,'/Output/Freq.csv')),
lm_stats=read.csv(paste0(folder,'/Maps_Results/Frescalo Tfactor lm stats.csv')),
log_file=readLines(paste0(folder,'/Output/Log.txt')),
in_data=read.table(paste0(folder,'/Input/FocDist.txt')),
spe_codes=read.csv(paste0(folder,'/species_names.csv')))

return(fresc.out)
}

#---------- frescS_it -----------#

frescS_it<-function(frescalo.results){

# Simple check to see if the input object has the right dimensions
if(!class(frescalo.results)=='list' | !length(frescalo.results)==8){stop('Please supply a list from the output of frescImport')}

# Find the benchmark limit from the log file!
log_bench<-frescalo.results$log_file[grep('Benchmark limit is', frescalo.results$log_file)] # find part of log file with benchmark info
R_ast<-as.numeric(gsub('[[:alpha:]]', '', log_bench)) # extract the number from the string

# Find the time periods
time.periods<-unique(frescalo.results$trend$Time)

# Make output data frame. Probably a nicer way, but I wanted to make it adjust according to number of time periods.
out.df<-setNames(as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(frescalo.results$freq$Location)),ncol=length(time.periods)+1)),c('grid.square',time.periods))
out.df$grid.square<-unique(frescalo.results$freq$Location)

# Now loop for each grid square
for(sq in out.df$grid.square){
freq.sq.bench<-frescalo.results$freq$Species[frescalo.results$freq$Location==sq & frescalo.results$freq$Rank1<R_ast] # identify benchmark species for the neighbourhood
freq.sq.bench.codes<-frescalo.results$spe_codes$SPECIES[frescalo.results$spe_codes$NAME %in% freq.sq.bench] # find what the codes for those species are
in.sq<-frescalo.results$in_data[frescalo.results$in_data$V1==sq,] # subset in data to make the following more readable
out.df[out.df$grid.square==sq,2:ncol(out.df)]<-sapply(time.periods, function(x) sum(freq.sq.bench.codes %in% in.sq$V2[in.sq$V3==x])/length(freq.sq.bench)) # calculate proportion of benchmark species for each time period and add it to the output
}

return(out.df)
}

```


```{r}
#| label: alistair
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# First just choose your folder - usually would have a name like frescalo_210805(1)
todays_date <- format(today(), "%y%m%d")
  
out.path<- str_glue('{output_path}/frescalo_{todays_date}')

# 1. Make your frescalo results list
fresc.res <- frescImport(out.path)

# 2. Calculate sampling effort (proportion of benchmark species) per sampling period
fresc.samp<-frescS_it(fresc.res)
```

Save outputs

```{r}
#| label: save-output
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

year_atlas_1 <- colnames(fresc.samp)[-1][1]
year_atlas_2 <- colnames(fresc.samp)[-1][2]
year_atlas_3 <- colnames(fresc.samp)[-1][3]

bm_sp_1 <- 
  left_join(atlas_data %>% 
              filter(year == as.numeric(year_atlas_1)) %>% 
              select(site, siteID, effort_1=effort) %>% unique(),
            fresc.samp %>% 
              rename(site = grid.square,
                     bm_sp_1 = year_atlas_1) %>% 
              select(site, bm_sp_1)) %>% select(-site) 

bm_sp_2 <- 
  left_join(atlas_data %>% 
              filter(year == as.numeric(year_atlas_2)) %>% 
              select(site, siteID, effort_2=effort) %>% unique(),
            fresc.samp %>% 
              rename(site = grid.square,
                     bm_sp_2 = year_atlas_2) %>% 
              select(site, bm_sp_2)) %>% select(-site)

bm_sp_3 <- 
  left_join(atlas_data %>% 
              filter(year == as.numeric(year_atlas_3)) %>% 
              select(site, siteID, effort_3=effort) %>% unique(),
            fresc.samp %>% 
              rename(site = grid.square,
                     bm_sp_3 = year_atlas_3) %>% 
              select(site, bm_sp_3)) %>% select(-site)


atlas_sampling_effort <- left_join(atlas_grid %>% 
                                     select(site=rowid, siteID, scalingID, datasetID),
                                   full_join(full_join(st_drop_geometry(bm_sp_1), 
                                                       st_drop_geometry(bm_sp_2)), 
                                             st_drop_geometry(bm_sp_3))) %>%
  select(-site) %>% arrange(siteID)

saveRDS(atlas_sampling_effort, str_glue('data/effort_frescalo_{atlas_id}.rds'))
```

## Plots

```{r}
#| label: plots
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

signif.num <- function(x) {
    symnum(x, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, legend = FALSE,
           cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), 
           symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", " "))
}

# atlas 1

plot_atlas_1_effort <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = atlas_sampling_effort, aes(fill = effort_1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = 'transparent') +
  labs(title= str_glue('Atlas 1 ({time_periods$start[1]} - {time_periods$end[1]})'),
       subtitle = 'Raw effort') +
  theme_bw() + coord_sf(crs = 4326)

plot_atlas_1_bm_sp <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = atlas_sampling_effort, aes(fill = bm_sp_1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = 'transparent') +
  labs(title= str_glue('Atlas 1 ({time_periods$start[1]} - {time_periods$end[1]})'),
       subtitle = 'Proportion of benchmark species') +
  theme_bw() + coord_sf(crs = 4326)

cor_CZ_1 <- cor.test(atlas_sampling_effort$bm_sp_1,atlas_sampling_effort$effort_1,
                     method = 'kendall', use='pairwise.complete.obs') 

plot_atlas_1_vs <- ggplot(atlas_sampling_effort, aes(bm_sp_1,effort_1))+
  geom_point()+ 
  # ylim(c(0,1)) + xlim(c(0,1)) +
  # geom_abline(linetype = 'dashed', col='red', lwd=1) + 
  labs(title= str_glue('Atlas 1 ({time_periods$start[1]} - {time_periods$end[1]})'),
       subtitle = 'Proportion of benchmark species vs raw effort') + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
  annotate(geom='text', x=0.75, y=max(atlas_sampling_effort$effort_1, na.rm=T)*0.75,
           label = str_glue('tau = {round(as.numeric(cor_CZ_1$estimate),3)}{signif.num(as.numeric(cor_CZ_1$p.value))}'))


plot_atlas_1_effort
plot_atlas_1_bm_sp
plot_atlas_1_vs
```
